CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.role_rank(p_role text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select public.role_rank( lower(replace(trim(p_role),' ','_'))::public.app_role );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.role_rank(p_role app_role)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select case p_role
    when 'exhibitor'::public.app_role         then 1
    when 'reporting_clerk'::public.app_role   then 2
    when 'superintendent'::public.app_role    then 3
    when 'admin'::public.app_role             then 4
    when 'super_admin'::public.app_role       then 5
    else 0
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.user_can_manage_show(p_show_id uuid, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    -- GLOBAL SUPER ADMIN
    exists (
      select 1
      from public.role_assignments ra
      where ra.user_id = coalesce(p_user_id, auth.uid())
        and ra.role::text = 'super_admin'
    )

    -- SHOW CREATOR
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.shows s
      where s.id = p_show_id
        and s.created_by = coalesce(p_user_id, auth.uid())
    )

    -- SHOW-LEVEL ROLES
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.role_assignments ra
      where ra.show_id = p_show_id
        and ra.user_id = coalesce(p_user_id, auth.uid())
        and ra.role::text in (
          'admin',
          'reporting_clerk',
          'superintendent'
        )
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_global_role_at_least(p_min_role text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.role_assignments ra
    where ra.user_id = auth.uid()
      and public.role_rank(ra.role::text)
          >= public.role_rank(p_min_role)
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.user_can_manage_show(p_show_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select public.user_can_manage_show(p_show_id, auth.uid());
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_show_payment_to_balance(p_show_payment_id uuid)
 RETURNS show_exhibitor_balances
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_payment public.show_payments%rowtype;
  v_balance public.show_exhibitor_balances%rowtype;

  v_paid_online_cents integer := 0;
  v_paid_manual_cents integer := 0;
  v_refunded_cents integer := 0;
  v_balance_due_cents integer := 0;
  v_payment_status text := 'unpaid';

  v_latest_payment_id uuid;
  v_latest_checkout_session_id text;
  v_latest_payment_intent_id text;
begin
  select *
  into v_payment
  from public.show_payments sp
  where sp.id = p_show_payment_id;

  if v_payment.id is null then
    raise exception 'show_payments row % not found', p_show_payment_id;
  end if;

  if v_payment.balance_id is null then
    raise exception 'show_payments row % is missing balance_id', p_show_payment_id;
  end if;

  select *
  into v_balance
  from public.show_exhibitor_balances seb
  where seb.id = v_payment.balance_id;

  if v_balance.id is null then
    raise exception 'show_exhibitor_balances row % not found', v_payment.balance_id;
  end if;

  -- Sum successful online Stripe/card payments for this balance.
  select
    coalesce(sum(
      case
        when sp.status in ('paid', 'partially_refunded')
          and coalesce(sp.payment_method, '') <> 'manual'
          and coalesce(sp.provider, '') <> 'manual'
        then coalesce(sp.amount_cents, sp.total_cents, 0)
        else 0
      end
    ), 0)::integer,

    coalesce(sum(
      case
        when sp.status in ('paid', 'partially_refunded')
          and (
            coalesce(sp.payment_method, '') = 'manual'
            or coalesce(sp.provider, '') = 'manual'
          )
        then coalesce(sp.amount_cents, sp.total_cents, 0)
        else 0
      end
    ), 0)::integer,

    coalesce(sum(
      case
        when sp.status in ('refunded', 'partially_refunded')
        then coalesce(sp.amount_cents, sp.total_cents, 0)
        else 0
      end
    ), 0)::integer
  into
    v_paid_online_cents,
    v_paid_manual_cents,
    v_refunded_cents
  from public.show_payments sp
  where sp.balance_id = v_payment.balance_id;

  v_balance_due_cents :=
    greatest(
      coalesce(v_balance.calculated_total_cents, 0)
      - coalesce(v_paid_online_cents, 0)
      - coalesce(v_paid_manual_cents, 0)
      + coalesce(v_refunded_cents, 0),
      0
    );

  v_payment_status :=
    case
      when coalesce(v_balance.calculated_total_cents, 0) <= 0 then 'paid'
      when (coalesce(v_paid_online_cents, 0) + coalesce(v_paid_manual_cents, 0))
           > coalesce(v_balance.calculated_total_cents, 0)
        then 'overpaid'
      when v_balance_due_cents = 0 then 'paid'
      when (coalesce(v_paid_online_cents, 0) + coalesce(v_paid_manual_cents, 0)) > 0
        then 'partial'
      when exists (
        select 1
        from public.show_payments pending_sp
        where pending_sp.balance_id = v_payment.balance_id
          and pending_sp.status in ('pending', 'processing', 'requires_action')
      )
        then 'pending'
      else 'unpaid'
    end;

  select
    sp.id,
    coalesce(sp.checkout_session_id, sp.stripe_checkout_session_id),
    coalesce(sp.payment_intent_id, sp.stripe_payment_intent_id)
  into
    v_latest_payment_id,
    v_latest_checkout_session_id,
    v_latest_payment_intent_id
  from public.show_payments sp
  where sp.balance_id = v_payment.balance_id
  order by sp.updated_at desc nulls last, sp.created_at desc nulls last
  limit 1;

  update public.show_exhibitor_balances seb
  set
    paid_online_cents = coalesce(v_paid_online_cents, 0),
    paid_manual_cents = coalesce(v_paid_manual_cents, 0),
    refunded_cents = coalesce(v_refunded_cents, 0),
    balance_due_cents = v_balance_due_cents,
    payment_status = v_payment_status,
    latest_show_payment_id = v_latest_payment_id,
    latest_checkout_session_id = v_latest_checkout_session_id,
    latest_payment_intent_id = v_latest_payment_intent_id,
    updated_at = now()
  where seb.id = v_payment.balance_id
  returning *
  into v_balance;

  return v_balance;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assign_show_coop_numbers(p_show_id uuid, p_scope_mode text DEFAULT 'separate'::text, p_overwrite_existing boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_count integer := 0;
begin
  if p_scope_mode not in ('separate', 'combined') then
    raise exception 'Invalid coop scope mode: %', p_scope_mode;
  end if;

  if not (
    public.user_can_manage_entries(p_show_id)
    or public.has_global_role_at_least('super_admin')
  ) then
    raise exception 'Not authorized to assign coop numbers';
  end if;

  update public.shows
  set coop_numbering_mode = p_scope_mode
  where id = p_show_id;

  /*
   * Remove assignments from the other numbering mode.
   * Regenerate All removes every existing assignment.
   */
  if p_overwrite_existing then
    delete from public.show_animal_coop_numbers
    where show_id = p_show_id;
  elsif p_scope_mode = 'combined' then
    delete from public.show_animal_coop_numbers
    where show_id = p_show_id
      and scope in ('open', 'youth');
  else
    delete from public.show_animal_coop_numbers
    where show_id = p_show_id
      and scope = 'all';
  end if;

  with candidate_rows as (
    select
      e.animal_id,

      case
        when p_scope_mode = 'combined' then 'all'
        else lower(coalesce(ss.kind::text, 'open'))
      end as scope,

      coalesce(e.species::text, '') as species_name,
      coalesce(e.breed::text, '') as breed_name,
      coalesce(e.variety::text, '') as variety_name,
      coalesce(e.class_name::text, '') as class_name,
      coalesce(e.sex::text, '') as sex_name,
      coalesce(e.tattoo::text, '') as tattoo_sort,

      e.id::text as stable_entry_id,

      coalesce(ss.sort_order, 9999) as section_sort_order,
      coalesce(ss.letter::text, '') as section_letter,

      /*
       * Cavies use SOP variety order.
       * Rabbits use varieties.sort_order.
       */
      coalesce(
        case
          when lower(coalesce(e.species::text, '')) = 'cavy'
            then cso.variety_sort_order
          else v.sort_order
        end,
        9999
      ) as variety_sort_order,

      /*
       * Standard showing class order.
       */
      case
        when lower(trim(coalesce(e.class_name::text, '')))
          in ('senior', 'sr') then 10

        when lower(trim(coalesce(e.class_name::text, '')))
          in ('intermediate', 'inter', 'int') then 20

        when lower(trim(coalesce(e.class_name::text, '')))
          in ('junior', 'jr') then 30

        when lower(
          replace(
            replace(trim(coalesce(e.class_name::text, '')), '-', ' '),
            '_',
            ' '
          )
        ) in ('pre junior', 'prejunior') then 40

        when lower(trim(coalesce(e.class_name::text, '')))
          in ('fur', 'wool', 'fur / wool', 'fur/wool') then 90

        else 80
      end as class_sort_order,

      /*
       * Buck/boar before doe/sow.
       */
      case lower(trim(coalesce(e.sex::text, '')))
        when 'buck' then 1
        when 'boar' then 1
        when 'doe' then 2
        when 'sow' then 2
        else 9
      end as sex_sort_order

    from public.entries e

    join public.show_sections ss
      on ss.id = e.section_id

    left join public.breeds b
      on lower(trim(b.name::text)) =
         lower(trim(coalesce(e.breed::text, '')))
     and lower(trim(b.species::text)) =
         lower(trim(coalesce(e.species::text, '')))

    left join public.varieties v
      on v.breed_id = b.id
     and lower(trim(v.name::text)) =
         lower(trim(coalesce(e.variety::text, '')))

    left join public.cavy_sop_variety_order cso
      on lower(trim(cso.breed_name)) =
         lower(trim(coalesce(e.breed::text, '')))
     and lower(trim(cso.variety_name)) =
         lower(trim(coalesce(e.variety::text, '')))

    where e.show_id = p_show_id
      and e.animal_id is not null
      and e.scratched_at is null
      and lower(ss.kind::text) in ('open', 'youth')
  ),

  /*
   * Select one representative class row per animal/scope.
   * Normal breed classes sort ahead of Fur/Wool rows.
   */
  animal_scope as (
    select distinct on (animal_id, scope)
      animal_id,
      scope,
      species_name,
      breed_name,
      variety_name,
      class_name,
      sex_name,
      tattoo_sort,
      stable_entry_id,
      section_sort_order,
      section_letter,
      variety_sort_order,
      class_sort_order,
      sex_sort_order

    from candidate_rows

    order by
      animal_id,
      scope,
      class_sort_order,
      variety_sort_order,
      sex_sort_order,
      section_sort_order,
      section_letter,
      stable_entry_id
  ),

  prefixed as (
    select
      a.*,

      coalesce(
        nullif(trim(ba.abbreviation::text), ''),

        upper(
          case
            when trim(a.breed_name) = '' then 'XX'

            when array_length(
              regexp_split_to_array(trim(a.breed_name), '\s+'),
              1
            ) >= 2 then
              left(
                (regexp_split_to_array(trim(a.breed_name), '\s+'))[1],
                1
              )
              ||
              left(
                (regexp_split_to_array(trim(a.breed_name), '\s+'))[2],
                1
              )

            else
              left(
                regexp_replace(
                  trim(a.breed_name),
                  '[^A-Za-z0-9]',
                  '',
                  'g'
                ),
                2
              )
          end
        )
      ) as breed_prefix

    from animal_scope a

    left join public.breed_abbreviations ba
      on lower(trim(ba.breed_name::text)) =
         lower(trim(a.breed_name))
     and lower(trim(ba.species::text)) =
         lower(trim(a.species_name))
  ),

  numbered as (
    select
      animal_id,
      scope,
      breed_name,

      breed_prefix ||
      row_number() over (
        /*
         * Partition by actual breed, not merely abbreviation.
         * This prevents missing-abbreviation collisions from
         * combining two breeds into one sequence.
         */
        partition by
          scope,
          lower(species_name),
          lower(breed_name)

        order by
          variety_sort_order,
          class_sort_order,
          sex_sort_order,
          lower(tattoo_sort),
          section_sort_order,
          section_letter,
          stable_entry_id
      )::text as coop_number

    from prefixed
  )

  insert into public.show_animal_coop_numbers (
    show_id,
    animal_id,
    scope,
    breed_name,
    coop_number,
    is_manual,
    generated_at,
    updated_at
  )
  select
    p_show_id,
    n.animal_id,
    n.scope,
    n.breed_name,
    n.coop_number,
    false,
    now(),
    now()
  from numbered n
  where p_overwrite_existing
     or not exists (
       select 1
       from public.show_animal_coop_numbers existing
       where existing.show_id = p_show_id
         and existing.animal_id = n.animal_id
         and existing.scope = n.scope
         and nullif(trim(existing.coop_number), '') is not null
     )

  on conflict (show_id, animal_id, scope)
  do update set
    breed_name = excluded.breed_name,

    coop_number = case
      when p_overwrite_existing
        then excluded.coop_number

      when show_animal_coop_numbers.coop_number is null
        or trim(show_animal_coop_numbers.coop_number) = ''
        then excluded.coop_number

      else show_animal_coop_numbers.coop_number
    end,

    is_manual = case
      when p_overwrite_existing then false
      else show_animal_coop_numbers.is_manual
    end,

    generated_at = case
      when p_overwrite_existing
        or show_animal_coop_numbers.coop_number is null
        or trim(show_animal_coop_numbers.coop_number) = ''
        then now()
      else show_animal_coop_numbers.generated_at
    end,

    updated_at = now();

  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;

  return v_count;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.user_can_email_reports(p_show_id uuid, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select public.user_can_manage_show(
    p_show_id,
    coalesce(p_user_id, auth.uid())
  );
$function$
